integrity_statement: The findings distinguish prior numerical-range dichotomy and prior general ridge-function independence themes from the stated coordinate classification and exponent-family conclusion. Self-review only; no independent audit.
limitations: Complex finite-dimensional standard ell_p norms with 1<p<infinity only.
All-order assertions use analytic arguments; finite checks are diagnostic.
Even-exponent coefficient matrix gives exact rank, not a closed-form rank in every domain.
The construction realizes initial segments of even exponents; no classification of all realizable exponent sets is claimed.
An equivalent formulation in uninspected older literature is possible.
title: Projective-coordinate rigidity and even-exponent numerical-range phases for finite-dimensional linear relations
